summary: New in glirastes/contracts: the view context contract (what the user looks at, declared by the app): entry types and schemas, sanitizeViewContext for untrusted input and resolveViewContextPolicy for the coming viewContext server option. Nothing uses it yet.
howTo: Nothing to do. sanitizeViewContext(input, { declaredTypes, factsSchemas, policy }) keeps up to 8 entries (a record of a declared entity type, a list view selection, or both) and drops invalid entries or fields with content-free reason counts (each stops at VIEW_CONTEXT_LIMITS.maxDropCount, 1,000,000: exact up to that many dropped, a lower bound only beyond); facts are kept only against a schema with safeParse (Zod or the runtime's JSON schema validator). The chat handler option viewContext and its model block are in this release too (see view-context-handler); the browser registry follows later.
